title: Business Analyst / Identity Access Management
text: Business Analyst / Identity Access Management at Davidson Technology (Melbourne, CBD & Inner Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). Great opportunity for an experienced Business Analyst with Identity Access Management Analysis and Process Documentation experience. This role is an initial 6 month contract but with a view to extensions. Working as part of a large-scale Transformation you will be responsible for Business Analysis related to a Member Portal piece of work. Responsibilities: Business Analysis for Functional and Non-Functional analysis and documentation Helping the business to enable the key business needs to be translated into technical specifications Help facilitate the delivery of an enhanced experience in the IDAM space Requirements gathering, Data, process mapping and data modelling Skills/ Experience Required 5 years+ experience as a BA with proven experience working on Identity Access Management projects, ideally related to member portals Excellent analytical skills Solid Technical knowledge and experience with modern technologies Application, Cloud and Web Sound knowledge on Business Process and Workflow documentation Knowledge of Information and System Security Technologies Strong interpersonal skills with both direct team members and senior stakeholders Excellent written and verbal communications skills Identity and Access Management, including solid understanding of IDAM concepts (joiners, movers, leavers, roles and entitlements, etc.) To apply, click the link and upload your current resume in word format. If you would like to have a confidential discussion, please contact David Sparks on 03 9929 9509, quoting ref no. JO-1804-88484. Want to know more about Davidson? Visit us at www.davidsonwp.com
